title: VexRiscv (SpinalHDL/VexRiscv)
_note: SpinalHDL emits VexRiscv.v from `sbt runMain vexriscv.demo.GenFull` (the
repository no longer ships pre-generated Verilog): the GenFull configuration
-- MMU, caches, debug, mul/div, CSRs -- as one file holding the core and its
cache / FIFO submodules.  test/ext_ip/vexriscv_setup.sh installs sbt
user-locally when missing and runs the generation; a JDK is the one
prerequisite assumed present.  3 rows: the core and its two caches.
First local sweep 2026-10-25: 3 / 3 proven, 3 / 3 co-sim PASS, 0 divergences.
